intent_en: To illustrate the timeline and key phases of the US military conflict in Iraq, from the 2003 invasion through the insurgency and surge to the withdrawal in 2010.
previous_intent: To illustrate the timeline of US military involvement in Iraq, tracking key conflict phases from the 2003 invasion through the insurgency surge to the withdrawal in 2010.
narration_support: The hammer blows of the American attack started what turned into a decade of insurgency.
chart_support: Line chart spanning 2003 to 2010, marking key events: Invasion, Insurgency Grows, Surge Peaks, and US Forces Leave Cities.
evidence_note: The narration introduces the start of the conflict and the decade-long insurgency, while the chart visualizes this timeline (2003-2010) with specific labeled phases of military engagement and troop movements.
